rics.meaning: Bank Indonesia: total assets — the central bank balance sheet asset side. Includes FX reserves (largest component, ~80%), claims on government, claims on banks, and other domestic assets.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks BI's monetary expansion. FX assets dominate — moves with reserve accumulation/intervention. Domestic asset growth (claims on government, claims on banks) reflects unconventional easing or liquidity provision. 2020 COVID saw unprecedented BI bond purchases under burden-sharing arrangements.

rics.meaning: Bank Indonesia: total liabilities — currency in circulation, bank reserve deposits, government deposits, BI Certificates (SBI), and BI bills (SDBI).
rics.how_to_use: Mirror of total assets by accounting identity. Currency in circulation is the largest stable component; bank reserves at BI absorb daily liquidity fluctuations. SBI/SDBI issuance is BI's main sterilization tool — rising stock indicates BI absorbing excess system liquidity.
